params.prompt: Website hero screen, flat UI design, 16:9. Background: flat cool blue-white #EEF3F4. Left 60%: the photo image 1 in a plain rectangle, no rounded corners. Over the shirt is a hard-edged circular lens about 38% of the photo's height, with a thin #0D1117 ring and two small tick marks. Inside the circle, show the matching area of image 2 so the shirt reads khaki inside the circle and pink outside. Under the photo, small text in #0D1117: "1 = your eyes (deutan, simulated) · 2 = everyone else". Right 40%: an optician's eye chart in black capital letters, Sloan-style, each line smaller than the one above: "YOU SEE" / "STONE" / "THEY SEE" / "ROSE" / "said in colour". Top-left wordmark "Said in Colour" in small black capitals. Bottom right: a two-segment pill, "ONE: YOU" / "TWO: EVERYONE", outlined in #0D1117, with the first segment filled #0072B2 and white text. A thin black line drawing of a phoropter sits faintly in the top-right corner. No gradients, no shadows, no glass blur, no cream, no gold. Use the two supplied photos exactly as they are (image 1 = everyone else's view, the real photo; image 2 = the colour-blind man's view): do not alter the man's face, body or shirt; no extra people; no logos; no brand names; all text spelled exactly as given.
